scope: tests/test_hw_review_publish_flow.py (15 new tests across 8 TestCase classes)
summary: All 10 TDD anchors from task-8 are covered, plus 5 additional scenarios (retry via teaser exception, requests.RequestException leaves row intact, URL identity across retry, missing-preview tolerance, stored-URL reuse at start). Tests exercise the real pending_articles_repo (no raw SQL for inserting rows); external boundaries are mocked at the module-under-test seam (hw_review.publish_article / hw_review.send_telegraph_teaser) rather than at the HTTP layer, matching task-8 §Details hint. Smoke target `test_publish_retry_reuses_telegraph_url` asserts mock_publish.call_count == 1 across two runs — the gating invariant. Full suite 339/339 green.

findings.finding: Uses tempfile mkstemp + patch('news_bot.DB_FILE', self.db_path) pattern identical to tests/test_integration.py and tests/test_hw_review_cli.py. Each test starts with a fresh DB, cleans up in tearDown. No cross-test state leakage.

Reuses the SAME MagicMock instances across both cmd_publish invocations (patch'ed inside a single `with` in run 1, re-patched identically in run 2). call_count therefore accumulates across runs — correct pattern for the Decision 9 assertion. Two variants cover False-return AND exception (TelegramError) to prove parity.
findings.recommendation: no action — matches task §TDD anchor hint verbatim

findings.finding: All three branches covered (already_published / in_failed / not_found) plus the plain out-of-range branch — four scenarios total. Each asserts: exit code 1, correct stderr content, AND that mock_publish + mock_teaser were NEVER called (no Python traceback risk and no accidental API hit).

The three vanished-row tests patch list_pending to return a dict with the link AFTER deleting the pending row, to simulate a race. An alternative would have been to keep a second pending row to seed the index. The patch approach is cleaner and more explicit about the race being simulated. Minor comment-only improvement possible (call out 'race simulation' in the fixture), but the current inline comments already do.

Decision 14 guard: asserts the second positional arg to send_telegraph_teaser is the row's link (lamleygroup.com URL), NOT the source_name string 'lamley'. Spot-checks news_bot._source_hashtag on the passed URL yields '#lamleygroup'. Exactly the check the task's AC demanded.

Happy path: real tempfile is created, set_preview_path'ed on the row, then asserted GONE after publish. Missing-file path: bogus path set, publish must succeed (FileNotFoundError tolerated in _cleanup_preview_html).
One class per concern (Happy/Retry/Vanished/Precondition/Telegraph-fail/Hashtag/Preview/Stored-URL). Test names are descriptive and match the task's anchor names one-for-one where they overlap.

findings.where: No test for Decision 1 path-guard interaction with _cleanup_preview_html
findings.finding: The cleanup test uses a tempfile NOT inside CACHE_DIR (it uses tempfile.mkstemp directly). The path-guard that limits preview files to CACHE_DIR is enforced at WRITE time by the preview subcommand (Task 7), so _cleanup_preview_html does not need to re-validate. A test enforcing 'cleanup refuses paths outside CACHE_DIR' would be overreach — the helper is deliberately path-agnostic so Task 9's _fallback_publish can reuse it with its own path source.
